# Rabbit Chain

Official website: https://rabbitchain.org
Official GitHub: https://github.com/rabbitmainnet
Official X: https://x.com/rabbit_mainnet

Rabbit Chain is a permissionless EVM Layer 1 powered by LCQ Consensus. Rabbit Testnet (Chain ID 9280) is the first public network. Rabbit Mainnet (Chain ID 928) follows validation.
Current Rabbit Core Testnet release: v2.4.3 (source commit c82bc245883333446daba20b1ece2ab9424991d0).
Rabbit Core v2.4.3 is the current consensus liveness recovery release. It preserves the existing Testnet chain and active Rabbit VRF rules.
Rabbit VRF DKG preparation started at block 136065. Rabbit VRF protocol and the VRF liveness rules activated at block 136193. The public Testnet crossed the activation block successfully and Rabbit VRF is active.

Key routes: /testnet, /mainnet, /lcq, /platform, /developers, /docs, /security, /releases, /status.
